roles.meaning: External input not determined inside the modeled system.
Variable jointly determined inside the modeled system.
System state carried across time or transitions.
Unobserved construct inferred from observed evidence.
Parameter required for estimation but not the decision target.
Variable entering a hard or soft feasibility boundary.
Variable changing the magnitude or direction of an effect.
Common cause of exposure or treatment and outcome.
Variable affecting treatment but excluded from the outcome equation except through treatment.
Intervention or assigned exposure under causal analysis.
Observed condition whose effect is being assessed.
